Notoriety: Wanted.description:
🚨 You are wanted: your face or mask is on police bulletins and hero agency briefings.

⚠️ Officers and heroes act on sight, brokers raise their prices, informants are tempted.
🧊 Lay low to let it cool.
Notoriety: Wanted.traitNarrativeEffects: The character is wanted by the police: a photo or a clear description (with any mask or costume) is on police bulletins and the briefing boards of local hero agencies, and the news has run the story at least once. Officers and pros who recognize the character act on sight; checkpoints and transit cameras are a real risk; brokers like Giran charge more and informants are tempted by the reward. Ordinary people may recognize the face. Laying low for days lowers the pressure; more crimes raise it.
